The accuracy code is made up of the following values: - The verification status - The post-processed verification match level - The pre-processed verification match level - The parsing status - The lexicon identification match level - The context identification match level - The postcode status - The matchscore
Verification Status V: Verified (A complete match was made between the input data and a single record from the available reference data) P: Partially Verified (A partial match was made between the input data and a single record from the available reference data) U: Unverified (Unable to verify. The output fields will contain the input data) A: Ambiguous (More than one close reference data match) R: Reverted (Record could not be verified to the specified minimum acceptable level. The output fields will contain the input data)
